source: inputs: 01 § Increment 2, Fixtures FX-011 (drafted by be-analyst #3). Expected: REQ-030 Accept ('每条含该名字；改过名的不含"小伙伴"/"Little Buddy"'). 01 and 02 send a custom name; 03 omits name (the legitimately absent shape, DES-021: absent = default name). 03 [unverified]: REQ-028 / A26 make the default name 小伙伴 or Little Buddy by UI language, and the UI language never reaches the backend (03 § Increment 2 §9), so either default form passes; the zh line would normally give 小伙伴 (REQ-005). 团子 and Mochi are unchanged by the name rule (FX-012 row 01; Mochi has nothing to clean).
compare_note: Per case, the test builds {status, reply_checks} from the actual response (POST /api/respond {line, history[, name]} -> 200 {reply, mood, lang, crisis, speech}, 03 § Increment 2 §9) with the rules in `rules` and compares it exactly. The expected keys of reply_checks differ per case: compute only the keys the case lists.

rules.normalise: NFC, toLowerCase, runs of whitespace -> one space
rules.contains_name: normalised reply contains the normalised name sent in body.name
rules.no_default_name: normalised reply contains neither '小伙伴' nor 'little buddy'
rules.contains_default_name: normalised reply contains '小伙伴' or 'little buddy'

pass: REQ-030: the whole expected object exact in 3/3 runs for every case
